title: The Hush
description: The Hush in an intelligent entity that resides in the dark. It learns from your behavior and tries to trick you. Do NOT fall for it.
body:
![The Hush banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/APTv6RrS/images/276a0a960945a276c92ee9ea0d5aae95108f83b2.png)
> 
> “Day 35. It goes for the light. I watched a torch vanish from my wall. There was no sound, no fire, just... sudden, suffocating darkness. All I can sense now are the footsteps.”
> 
***

Minecraft's darkness has always been pretty safe. **Not anymore.**

The Hush is a psychological horror mod designed to make you dread the places you think are safe. Instead of spawning random, loud monsters that run at you to jumpscare you, it introduces a silent, patient presence that watches you, maps out the paths you repeat on autopilot, and slowly turns your own familiar routines against you.

***

### What is waiting in the dark?

**It watches from the shadows** - Vigilance is rewarded

**The paranoia starts small** - A torch gets snuffed out when your back is turned. A faint, irregular heartbeat echoes behind a solid stone wall

**It remembers where you feel safe** - The staircase you dug, the mine branch you run down without looking, the small nook where you sleep - these are the paths it registers and targets

**Your base isn't safe** - While you are away, it can tamper with your home. You might find doors opened, torches snuffed out or chests messed with

**It mimics your sounds** - You might hear your own actions echoed back to you. If you are mining, placing blocks, or running in a cave, you might hear those exact sounds replayed from the dark tunnels behind you

**Do not trust everything you find** - It can set up traps that will attract it

**Secrets & Abductions** - Deep underground, you will discover procedurally generated structures like outposts, shrines, and bone-filled crypts containing lost journals. But greed is punished here - make sure you are actually alone before you start looting. If you are caught, you aren't always just killed, you can get dragged down into escape chambers where you have to find a way out

***

### Survival Tips

*   **Listen carefully**
*   **Break your routine**
*   **Keep your composure**

***
![image](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1558359/description_43838bb7-4a09-480f-acd4-dc29e1062d67.png)
***

### Technical Info

*   **Minecraft Version:** 1.20.1 (Forge)
*   **Required Dependency:** [GeckoLib 4.8.3](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/geckolib/files/7553267)
*   **Multiplayer:** Synced server-to-client events ensure visual and auditory scares are routed per-player, keeping the paranoia personal
*   **Customization:** You can adjust block-breaking permissions, safety bounds, and scare thresholds in config/thehush-server.toml
*   **Status:** The mod is officially released, but bugs may still occur. If you find any bugs or have suggestions/feedback feel free to message me on Discord: thiefofeden  / or you can just use the comments

***

### [I highly recommend playing this mod with my modpack, but feel free to use it in your own modpack or just by itself](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/horror-template)
